messages:
Jin W: Hey team, corpcard soft-declined at the restaurant last night so I covered the bill on my personal card. Need to submit for reimbursement and check VAT reclaim possibility.

Amount: EUR 89.70 (posted 2026-03-18)
Receipt: https://files.redwood/receipts/2026-03-18-restaurant.jpg
I started a claim in Concur: `EXP-2026-0487`

Priya (Finance): Thanks Jin. Quick checklist: 1) Upload the itemized invoice or VAT receipt from the venue (we need vendor tax ID + VAT line to reclaim). 2) Attach your card statement showing the charge and last 4 digits. 3) Put original currency on the expense (EUR) so FX is applied automatically.

If vendor only provides a credit card slip w/o VAT, we reimburse the full amount but cant reclaim VAT. We can process reimbursement now and leave VAT as "pending" until invoice arrives.

Jin W: They emailed a PDF but it's just a generic credit-card receipt without VAT breakdown. I responded asking for a proper invoice with VAT ID. How should I mark the claim for now?

Priya (Finance): Mark it as EUR 89.70, category `Client dinner`, add note "invoice pending - vendor emailed cc slip". Submit it so manager can approve; we'll hold VAT reclaim status. If vendor sends invoice later, upload and tag me.

Marco T (Manager): Approving — client dinner and within approval limits.

ExpenseBot: Expense `EXP-2026-0487` status changed to `Submitted` by Jin W.

Jin W: Uploaded the credit card slip + statement. Tagged Priya. Also asked vendor for invoice number and tax ID, they said it may take 48 hours.

Priya (Finance): Got the upload. Once vendor invoice arrives and has VAT line, I'll open a VAT reclaim request. Note on timing: VAT reclaims for EU vendors usually process in the next monthly reclaim batch and can take 30-60 days to settle back to the company. You will get reimbursed for the full amount now; any VAT recovered after will be posted to finance and not split back to individuals.

Jin W: Cool, thanks. One more Q 1 is there any reimbursement tax impact I should be aware of?

Priya (Finance): No payroll tax impact for this client-facing meal. If you had personal benefit or non-business travel there might be different rules but this is standard business expense.

ExpenseBot: Expense `EXP-2026-0487` status changed to `Approved` by Marco T. Estimated processing within 5 business days.

Jin W: Thanks all 8077; I'll post the invoice if/when it arrives and @Priya I'll ping hereif they provide VAT details.

Priya (Finance): Perfect. If they send invoice please ensure it includes vendor name, tax ID, invoice number, VAT line and currency (EUR). That will let us reclaim.

Jin W: Invoice arrived, PDF attached (invoice no INV-4529, VAT 10.00 EUR, Tax ID: DE123456789). Uploaded to Concur and tagged Priya.

Priya (Finance): Received. Routing to VAT reclaim queue now. I'll update once it's submitted.

Jin W: Appreciate it, closing out on my side."
